links.comparator_used: Original, unsimplified AAO-HNS and children's hospital patient education materials
links.outcome: Flesch-Kincaid grade level of pediatric otolaryngology patient education materials
links.effect: AAO-HNS materials: 10.71 ± 0.71 to 7.9 ± 1.18 after ChatGPT (P < .01). Combined AAO-HNS and institutional materials: 9.32 ± 1.82 to 7.68 ± 1.12 (P = .0598).
links.tradeoff: ChatGPT did not reduce all materials below the recommended reading level; average output stayed around grade 7.7-7.9 despite a fifth-grade target. The reduction for the combined set was not statistically significant.
links.quote: After requesting the reduction of those materials to a fifth-grade reading level, ChatGPT converted the same materials to an average grade level of 7.9 ± 1.18 (P < .01).

links.comparator_used: Original materials before the fifth-grade prompt (pre/post comparison; no default-prompt arm)
links.outcome: Flesch-Kincaid grade level after prompting ChatGPT for a fifth-grade reading level
links.effect: AAO-HNS materials fell from 10.71 ± 0.71 to 7.9 ± 1.18 (P < .01); the combined set fell from 9.32 ± 1.82 to 7.68 ± 1.12 (P = .0598). The fifth-grade target was not reached.
links.tradeoff: Output missed the requested fifth-grade target and did not get all materials below the recommended level.
links.quote: However, it did not possess the capability to reduce all materials to be below the recommended reading level.

design_hint: reading-level constraint prompting to simplify patient education materials
